Mapping (bytes32 => Rotation) tracking in-progress node rotations per schain.

Array of SpaceManaging structs tracking free space and space-map index per node.
Array of locker contract names iterated by TokenState aggregation functions.
Mapping (validatorId => month => token) of bounty paid, used for withdrawal accounting.

Library function using inline assembly extcodehash to determine whether an address is a contract.

allow("SkaleManager") entrypoint that validates deposit/lifetime and creates a schain.

External function computing metrics and paying bounty, guarded by node existence and time checks.
External function withdrawing earned bounty and transferring ERC20 tokens to a destination.
Private function splitting a bounty into validator fee and holder bounty using feeRate.
View function performing BLS signature verification via the bn256 pairing precompile.
Library function parsing a 65-byte signature and calling ecrecover with malleability guards.
Private internal function pushing a Node struct and updating space/name/ip mappings and counters.
allowTwo-gated function decrementing a node's free space and moving it in the space map.
allow("DelegationController") function recording delegated amounts against locked tokens.
View function computing a lock-end timestamp from a month and lock-up period.
allow("SkaleManager") function computing and reducing bounty based on stage pool and node metrics.

External function verifying an ECDSA signature over the validatorId before linking a node address.
Caller-controlled address used across authorization checks and ownership/role grants.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for lock, reward and exit timing decisions.
Low-level call{value: amount}("") forwarding all gas to an arbitrary recipient address.
Inline assembly staticcall to precompile 0x05 for modular exponentiation.
ecrecover opcode call whose result is validated against address(0).
Unchecked index/counter arithmetic (length.sub(1), numberOfSchains--) during schain removal.
Unchecked decrement of numberOfActiveNodes / numberOfLeavingNodes when marking a node left.

edges.reason: The recipient address is supplied by the caller and is the target of the low-level value call, so a malicious contract can re-enter on receipt of ether.
The amount parameter flows directly into the value-bearing low-level call that hands control to the recipient.
Address.sendValue performs the external value transfer inside the function body before returning control.
The success flag of the low-level call is captured in the local success variable and required to be true.
Permissions.initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender, making the caller the privileged role holder.
Punisher.slash is gated by the allow modifier that compares msg.sender against the registered SkaleDKG address or owner.
grantRole authorizes based on msg.sender holding the target role's admin role.
DelegationController.delegate records msg.sender as the delegation holder and validates per-holder limits.
linkNodeAddress resolves the validator id from msg.sender before accepting the node address.
Bounty payout eligibility in SkaleManager.getBounty depends on block.timestamp-based reward timing.
calculateProofOfUseLockEndTime produces a timestamp compared against now to release locked tokens.
nodeExit sets node finish time using now plus a conditional rotation delay.
Bounty.getBounty compares now against stage/reward-period boundaries to size the payout.
The validatorId argument is consumed by Punisher.slash to locate the validator.
The amount argument is forwarded from Punisher.slash into DelegationController.confiscate.
Punisher.slash performs an external call to DelegationController.confiscate on the resolved contract.
Punisher.forgive mutates the _locked mapping by deleting or subtracting the holder's balance.
The forgiven amount is subtracted from the holder's entry in the _locked mapping.
ECDSA.recover executes the ecrecover opcode to derive the signer identity from the provided signature.
linkNodeAddress relies on ECDSA.recover to authorize the caller-supplied node address.
The signature bytes flow from the parameter into the recover call for verification.
SkaleVerifier.verify invokes the bn256 pairing precompile through Precompiled library helpers.
Address.isContract relies on the inline assembly extcodehash operation.
The account parameter is the operand of the extcodehash inspection.
The extcodehash result is stored into the local codehash variable.
The local codehash value drives the boolean return of isContract.
setContractsAddress computes the contract id hash into a local variable before the mapping write.
The contractsName parameter is hashed into the contractId used as the registry key.
The new contract address is written into the contracts mapping after validation.
The aggregation loop accumulates each locker's locked amount into the locked local variable.
TokenState iterates the _lockers array and calls getAndUpdateLockedAmount on each resolved locker.
handleDelegationAdd reads the locked balance of a holder to bound the newly delegated amount.
SkaleManager.createNode delegates node creation to Nodes._addNode via Nodes.createNode.
_addNode appends a new entry to spaceOfNodes and updates the space-to-nodes mapping.
deleteSchain triggers schain removal where length.sub(1) index swaps and numberOfSchains decrement occur.
nodeExit leads to state transitions that decrement active/leaving node counters.
addSchain ultimately invokes SchainsInternal._generateGroup to build the node group.
Group generation stores results into schainsGroups and interacts with node rotation bookkeeping.
SkaleManager.tokensReceived forwards userData to Schains.addSchain on ERC777 token receipt.
delegate pushes a new Delegation struct into the delegations array and related mappings.
confiscate reduces delegated values via PartialDifferences and records a slashing event.
withdrawBounty reads the _bountyPaid accounting before transferring tokens out.
removeSpaceFromNode updates spaceOfNodes.freeSpace and the spaceToNodes mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient is only meaningful as the destination argument of the Address.sendValue value transfer.
The transferred amount exists solely as the value argument of Address.sendValue.
The account argument is consumed only by the isContract code-size check.
The validator identifier is a per-call argument of Punisher.slash.
The slash amount is a per-call argument forwarded from Punisher.slash.
The holder address is a transient argument of Punisher.forgive.
The forgiven amount is a transient argument of Punisher.forgive.
The contract name is a transient argument hashed inside setContractsAddress.
The new address is a transient argument stored by setContractsAddress.
The signature is a transient argument verified inside linkNodeAddress.
The codehash local exists only within isContract to compare against the empty-code hash.
The success flag is only the outcome of the low-level value call made by sendValue.
The contractId local exists only as the computed registry key inside setContractsAddress.
The locked accumulator exists only within the locker aggregation loop.
